what: the reachability probe: one curl per host, run by hand ONCE on the date below from the build container through its egress proxy, and copied here as data. protocols/build.py READS this file and fetches nothing, so a rebuild is byte-identical; the date is the date of the measurement, not the date of the build.
how: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 <url>, once per host, no retry, TLS verification on, HTTPS_PROXY as configured, no proxy bypass; the body was discarded (-o /dev/null), so even a 2xx here would mean 'the host answered', never 'the spec was read'
meaning_of_000_56: no HTTP response from the host at all: curl exited 56 with 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403', so %{http_code} printed 000 - the egress proxy refused the CONNECT (organization policy denial); nothing came from the host itself
provenance: RECORDED - each code and exit is what curl printed on the date given
